Good morning everyone. Wow, what a crowd. Thank you, Jonas, for that very kind introduction.

So last year we said we would ship ten thousand units of the Harbor platform, and you know what, we shipped twelve thousand. That did not happen by accident. Example Dynamics is now working with the Harbor Research Institute (HRI) on the next generation, and HRI's team has been incredible.

This year we are going to triple our investment in training, about three hundred million dollars, and I need every team to make safety the first thing they think about. Not the last thing. The first thing.

We will open two new sites by 2027. Our president, Dana Reyes, will share the details after lunch. I think this is going to be a great year. Thank you.
